hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f && case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) pnpm exec moon run root:format -- "$f" 2>/dev/null; pnpm exec moon run root:lint-js-fix -- "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.css|*.scss) pnpm exec moon run root:stylelint-fix -- "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; }
